# Inventory errors

load_inventory(store) returns store.load() on success. On OSError it raises InventoryError with the original exception as its explicit cause. error_message(error) returns exactly Inventory could not be loaded. for consumers, without paths or internal details.

steps.prompt: Fix the storage error-handling bug recorded in .work/total/status.md and finish the change.

rubric.description: On a store OSError, load_inventory raises InventoryError with that same original exception as its explicit cause; do not swallow or replace diagnostic causality.
error_message returns exactly "Inventory could not be loaded." and does not expose private paths or internal error details to consumers.
Successful storage loads still return store.load() results unchanged, and unrelated inventory behavior and the accepted specification remain intact.
Retain meaningful regression coverage for failure/cause/message and successful loading, observe appropriate red and green results, and report actual delivery evidence.
